newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco winter-grade unleaded firms in Chicago.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco winter-grade unleaded firms in Chicago.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent winter-grade unleaded gasoline differentials firmed in Chicago on Thursday, pushing spot prices higher, traders said.
Diesel basis in the Chicago and Group Three markets was steady, with prices tracking modest gains in front-month heating oil futures in morning trade.

Traders said effects of two barge accidents and a grounded freighter that restricted shipping traffic along key segments of the Mississippi River in Louisiana had not rippled into the Midwest spot markets.

Winter-grade unleaded in Chicago was heard done 7.15 cents a gallon under the print during the final cycle before the seasonal changeover to summer-grade specifications. Summer-grade barrels were talked 3 cents a gallon under the print.
Group Three unleaded gasoline remained 3.75/3.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX April unleaded for prompt and late-March deliveries, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel for prompt deliveries remained 3.50/3.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Group Three and 3.75/4.0 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was talked 1.50/1.75 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three and 2.0/2.25 cents over the print in Chicago for all March timings, traders said.
